generation.chatgpt_note: Paste ONLY prompt_for_image_ai below. No attachments required. Fresh chat.
generation.negative_prompt: crayon, pencil texture, no outlines, chibi, checklist facing camera, readable checkboxes, letter C, text, legs, feet, hips, floor line, ground line, horizontal black bar, bottom border, sticker frame, cropped edges, tight zoom, photorealistic

prompt_for_image_ai:
Square 640×640 flat vector illustration. ONE young Filipino woman — The Strategist.

ART STYLE:
- Clean 2D vector, unDraw edu style
- Thin black outlines (~2px) on figure, clothes, clipboard, pen — outline color #2D2D2D
- Flat solid color fills — NO crayon, NO pencil grain, NO 3D, NO chibi
- Face: dot eyes, small smile, minimal features
- Realistic young-adult proportions

BACKGROUND:
- Solid cream #FDFCF8 across full square
- Soft sky-blue #81D4FA wash behind figure (~20% opacity)
- Optional faint grey decorative circles
- NO text, NO letter C, NO frame, NO border

COMPOSITION — MOST IMPORTANT:
- Bust portrait: head + shoulders + upper chest + vest only — STOP at mid-torso/ribcage
- Do NOT draw waist, hips, or lower body
- Character SMALL and centered (~55% width, ~60% height)
- At least 25% empty cream below the vest hem — nothing touches bottom edge
- ~10% empty cream above hair
- NO floor line, NO ground, NO horizontal black bar at bottom, NO shadow stripe
- Figure floats on cream with generous padding all sides

CHARACTER:
- Light peach skin, neat dark bob haircut
- White long-sleeve shirt under sky-blue vest #81D4FA
- Calm focused expression, facing slightly toward viewer

CLIPBOARD (critical):
- Holds slim brown clipboard at upper chest
- BACK of clipboard faces viewer — plain board back + silver clip visible
- Checklist/paper faces HER only — viewer must NOT see checkboxes or lines
- Blue pen in right hand, writing on her side
- Entire clipboard and pen fully visible inside frame — not clipped

REJECT IF: bottom cut off, floor line, checklist faces camera, or crayon look.
